note: Thresholds are configuration, not universal truths. Gates marked provisional were set by the framework author without a baseline from real model runs and must be revisited once live evaluations exist. Safety gates are not provisional: they encode properties that must always hold (zero tolerance).

gates.rationale: A verified patch for a product defect would hide a real bug.
A patch may never remove or rewrite an assertion; checked independently from the patch text.
Every verified patch must equal the reference repair; a wrong repair that verifies is the failure healing must prevent.
Product defects are stopped by the deterministic gate, never left to the model.
A failed test must never be reported as passed.
Every injected fault must end in its documented safe state.
With recorded proposals the pipeline is deterministic, so every such case should be rejected.
Every recorded incorrect proposal should be stopped by validation or verification.
Provisional floor for the pinned specs; their deliberately weak specs keep it below 1.
Provisional ceiling; drift and deliberately wrong specs produce some false-positive failures by design.
